components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Commits the single dominant action in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 12px; color: #fff; background: var(--primary, #006d95); border: 1px solid var(--primary, #006d95); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); font: 630 0.8125rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms, border-color 140ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #005982); border-color: var(--primary-hover, #005982); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,109,149,.24); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible or supporting action beside the dominant commit.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 12px; color: var(--ink, #06131b); background: var(--bg, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #95afbd); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); font: 630 0.8125rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms, border-color 140ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface, #f3f8fa); border-color: var(--primary, #006d95); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,109,149,.24); }

components.name: Text Field

narrative.overview: A founder opens Bot Combinator before the day’s first investor call and finds a prepared briefing desk: clear, exact, calm, and already arranged around the decisions that matter. The interface is a working instrument, not a performance of productivity.
keyCharacteristics: Bright paper and cool fog surfaces anchored by marine blue.
Compact records with generous reading rhythm and stable information architecture.
Evidence, freshness, privacy, and safety states visible at the point of action.
State transitions that are responsive, never choreographed.
A complete light theme, dark theme, and system-following theme with identical hierarchy.

rules.name: The Decision-First Rule
rules.body: Each page exposes the next safe action while keeping the evidence, uncertainty, and consequence in view.

rules.name: The Compact Rhythm Rule
rules.body: The product is information-dense without becoming cramped.

rules.name: The Restrained Signal Rule
rules.body: Paper, fog, ink, and dividers carry almost the entire product.

rules.name: The Evidence Has No Glow Rule
rules.body: Sourced facts and uncertainty are separated through labels, hierarchy, and metadata—not decorative gradients or luminous effects.

rules.name: The Quiet Authority Rule
rules.body: Inter Variable is the single product voice.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Records Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is reserved for money, dates, counts, identifiers, checksums, shortcuts, and similarly scan-sensitive values.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from tonal layers, one-pixel dividers, and space.

rules.name: The Consequence Floats Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong only to dialogs, command surfaces, menus, toasts, and active drag states.

rules.name: The Exact Approval Rule
rules.body: Any external send review must show the frozen recipient, subject, body, attachments, connector, suppression state, and approval boundary together.

dos: Do keep the founder’s next safe action visible without hiding evidence or context.
Do distinguish sourced facts, founder-entered facts, inferences, unknowns, and stale claims.
Do make send approval, suppression, connector access, agent disclosure, and local-storage status unmistakable.
Do preserve semantic HTML, keyboard completion, visible focus, reduced-motion behavior, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
Do use stable spatial structure and progressive disclosure for dense investor records.
donts: Don't reproduce generic CRM dashboards that turn every fact into a card and every workflow into configuration.
Don't use AI-purple gradients, neon accents, glassmorphism, decorative agent theater, or chat-first interfaces that hide records.
Don't use finance-terminal cosplay, navy-and-gold prestige styling, or dark-mode-only density.
Don't borrow growth-hacking or bulk-email patterns that reward volume, vanity metrics, or unattended sequences.
Don't make consequential outreach feel casual through consumer-playful styling.
Don't use color alone, hover-only controls, placeholder-only labels, inaccessible drag-only actions, or invisible focus.
